name: 45-day visa exemption (unilateral policy)
summary: Citizens of 12 countries can enter Vietnam without a visa for up to 45 days, any passport type and any purpose. The policy runs from March 15, 2025 to March 14, 2028 and may be extended.

other: You still have to meet Vietnam's normal entry conditions.
Belarus had a 45-day exemption from 2023 but was not in the 2025 list of 12 that we read. Check the MOFA list for Belarus.

stay.note: Counted from the date of entry. Policy valid March 15, 2025 to March 14, 2028.

sources.label: Government news: visa waiver for 12 countries until March 2028
Vietnam Embassy UK: exemption of entry visa to Viet Nam (2023 notice, 13 countries)

name: Visa exemption for other listed countries (treaty and ASEAN)
summary: Vietnam also exempts citizens of many other countries under bilateral deals, mostly for 14 to 90 days depending on the country and passport type. Check the official MOFA list for your passport.

other: MOFA lists about 96 countries and territories, with stays from 14 to 90 days depending on the country and passport type.

Examples on that list: ordinary passports from Thailand, Malaysia, Laos, Cambodia and Singapore are exempt for about 30 days, and the Philippines for 21 days. Confirm on the current list before traveling.
British National (Overseas) passports are not exempt.
Our copy of the MOFA page is a dated snapshot and mixes passport types, so the exact days per ordinary passport need review.
Czech, Polish and Swiss tour-group exemption ran only March 1 to December 31, 2025.

sources.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Viet Nam's visa exemption list

name: Phu Quoc island visa exemption
summary: Foreign passport holders can enter or leave through Phu Quoc without a visa for up to 30 days. This reportedly also works if you first pass through another Vietnamese border gate.

other: Listed on the MOFA exemption page, which is a dated snapshot. Confirm the current rule before relying on it.

sources.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Viet Nam's visa exemption list

name: Vietnam eVisa
summary: Citizens of all countries can apply online for an eVisa. It is valid up to 90 days, single or multiple entry, and works at listed airports, land border gates and seaports.

other: Open to all nationalities since August 15, 2023.
The eVisa fee, processing time and document list were not on any page we could read. The portal itself blocks automated reading. Check evisa.gov.vn.

stay.note: Validity of up to 90 days. Single or multiple entry.

steps: Apply on the official eVisa portal run by the Immigration Department.
Pick your entry border gate from the approved list (13 airports, 16 land gates and 13 seaports per the embassy notice).

name: Regular visa from an embassy
summary: You can apply for a regular visa at a Vietnamese embassy or consulate. Work, study and conference visas need an approval letter from Vietnamese immigration or consular authorities first.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months past your planned departure.
Employment, study and conference visas need an approval letter from Vietnamese authorities.

steps: Apply online through the embassy consular portal or in person.
Submit the form, photos and passport.
Pay the fee and wait for the visa.
documents: Two passport photos on a light background
Approval letter (work, study or conference visas)

fees.label: Multiple-entry visa, over 180 days to 1 year

name: Foreign worker work permit
summary: Most foreign employees need a work permit sponsored by a Vietnamese employer, then a work visa or temporary residence card. Several groups are exempt, including some company owners and certain intra-company transferees.

other: Degree and experience requirements were not confirmed from an official page.

Exempt groups include owners or capital contributors with at least VND 3 billion in a limited liability company, and certain managers, executives, experts and technical workers, including intra-company transferees with 12 months of prior employment.
Authorities decide within ten working days of a valid file, per Decree 219/2025.

steps: Employer files the request with the provincial People's Committee (Form 03).
Get the permit, then the matching visa or residence card.
processing: Authorities must decide within ten working days of receiving a valid file, per the Government news summary of the decree effective August 7, 2025.

sources.label: Government news: fresh regulations on work permits

name: Temporary residence card
summary: Foreigners who qualify for long stays can get a temporary residence card instead of renewing visas. Cards are issued for up to 2, 5 or 10 years depending on the category.

other: Who qualifies and the exact card length per category were not confirmed from an official page we could read. Check with the Immigration Department.

stay.note: Fee tiers cover cards up to 2 years, 2 to 5 years and 5 to 10 years.

name: Permanent residence card
summary: Vietnam issues a permanent residence card to foreigners who qualify, such as people with exceptional contributions. It is also needed before naturalization. Conditions and waiting time were not confirmed.

other: Eligibility rules and required years were not confirmed from an official page. Check with the Immigration Department.

name: Naturalization (Vietnamese nationality)
summary: Standard route needs five years living in Vietnam, fluent Vietnamese, a residence card and proof you can support yourself. Vietnam generally expects you to give up your old nationality.

eligibility.language: Fluent Vietnamese, enough to integrate into the community
other: Five years living in Vietnam before applying, plus a residence card.
Proof of income, assets or a guarantee from a Vietnamese person or organization.
Sources describe the rules in two ways (a permanent residence card in one, a residence card in another). Confirm which card is required.

citizenship.note: Dual nationality is generally not allowed. Exceptions exist for people with exceptional contributions who have close Vietnamese relatives and get the President's permission.

name: Naturalization for special merit, talent or investors
summary: People with special merit, outstanding talent, or long-term contributions as entrepreneurs or investors can get an easier route to Vietnamese nationality. A ministry has to confirm the contribution.

other: Special merit: state medal, noble title or confirmed special contribution.
Outstanding talent in science, culture, sports or education, recognized by ministries or international awards.
Entrepreneurs and investors confirmed by a ministerial-level agency.
Exact exemptions from the five-year and language rules were not confirmed.

citizenship.note: Some applicants may keep foreign nationality with the President's permission if they have close Vietnamese relatives.
